claim: Turn-it-in Chat GPT Detector -- Experiences? : r/Professors
summary: I teach business communications, and had multiple students score 100% on the AI detector portion of Turn it In. This detector was just launched in the last week or so and is not visible on the student's end. Turn-it-in claims 94% accuracy in AI detecting. The free AI detectors are pretty lousy at actually detecting AI content, so I'm wondering how much we can trust Turn it In.
